title: Patch: dungeon HP refills after every fight, and each win adds 5 max HP
thread:
**Issue #3584 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #3584: Patch: dungeon HP refills after every fight, and each win adds 5 max HP
Opened by @jgoetzmann.

### What it does

**Today** (§15.4, §15.6, §15.8), a run starts at `RUN_MAX_HP` (the engine's `HERO_HEALTH`, 30) and HP carries from fight to fight:
- a win sets HP to the hero's final health (`fight_won` in `crates/run/src/lib.rs`);
- the campfire's heal gives back `RUN_CAMPFIRE_HEAL_PERCENT` (30%) of max HP (`RunAction::Heal`);
- events trade HP (`RunEventOption.hp`; the placeholders' "Lose 5 HP for 50 Coins", "Bleed on it (8 HP) for an artifact").

**The owner's new rules (`crates/run`):**

- **Every fight won**, of any kind and bosses included, raises the run's max HP by `RUN_WIN_MAX_HP` (5) for the rest of the run, then refills HP to the new max, whatever the hero's final health was. So HP outside a fight always equals max HP, and every fight starts at full health. A lost fight still ends the run.
- **Max HP** is `RUN_MAX_HP`, plus the relics' and blessings' max-HP effects as now, plus the run's own permanent changes (the wins, campfires and events below). Keep those changes in the state (for example a `max_hp_bonus` field) so that `run_max_hp` reads them and `run_fold` replays them. A rise heals by the rise, as `with_max_hp` does today.
- **Events trade max HP instead of HP.**
  - `RunEventOption.hp` becomes a change to max HP; rename the field, for example `max_hp`.
  - The placeholder events in `crates/run/src/placeholder.json` say so ("Lose 5 max HP for 50 Coins").
  - An option is refused if it would leave max HP below 1, or below a floor constant if you add one.
- **The campfire's heal choice** becomes "+`RUN_CAMPFIRE_MAX_HP` (5) max HP", and `RUN_CAMPFIRE_HEAL_PERCENT` retires. Rename `RunAction::Heal` if the new name reads better. Its other choices (Radiant, buff, remove) are unchanged.
- **The fight's setup.** The human's hero health stays the run's HP (`run_fight_setup`), which is now always the max. A hero can start above `HERO_HEALTH` (R290). Check what in-game healing caps at for such a hero. If it is not the starting health, say so in the pull request: do not change the engine here.
- **Stats and run-sim.** Damage taken and healing taken still read the fights' reports. `cargo jackioh run-sim` (`crates/tools/src/run_sim.rs`) reports the max HP entering each boss where it reports the HP today.

**Screens (`apps/web/src/dungeon/`):**
- the top bar's HP (`RunDisplay.tsx`) shows the run's HP as max HP;
- the campfire's and the events' words change (`TileScreens.tsx`);
- every word goes through `t()`, and `apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json` gets the new strings.

**Docs:**
- §15.4 (max HP), §15.6 ("A win sets HP to the final health…"), §15.7 and §15.8 (Campfire, Event), and §15's constants table;
- `docs/dungeon-run.md`'s DR0 point 3 and DR7;
- `crates/run/README.md`;
- each decision the spec does not make gets a ruling in this issue's block (CLAUDE.md rule 3).

**Kept runs.** A kept run from before this change may no longer fold the same way (an event's option is now judged by max HP). #3496 ends such a run with a notice and keeps its extractions.

### Acceptance

- A won fight of each kind (Fight, Elite, Ghost, mini-boss, final boss) raises max HP by `RUN_WIN_MAX_HP` and sets HP to the new max, even when the hero ended the fight at 1 health.
- A lost fight still ends the run.
- Every fight's setup gives the human's hero health equal to the run's max HP.
- An event option's max-HP cost lowers max HP, and HP with it. An option that would leave max HP below the floor is refused, state unchanged.
- The campfire's max-HP choice raises max HP by `RUN_CAMPFIRE_MAX_HP`.
- A relic's or blessing's max-HP effect still adds on top, and leveling a relic still counts it once per level.
- `run_fold` replays a whole run to its end, `walk_tests` pass on both contents, and `cargo jackioh run-sim --seeds 1` runs clean.
- vitest: the campfire screen offers the max-HP choice, and an event's max-HP option shows its words.
- `cargo jackioh spec check` passes, and §15's constants table matches `config.rs`.

### Blocked by, part of

Blocked by #3496
Part of #3581

### Difficulty (a guess)

medium

### Priority

medium

### Who does it

The night bot (bot:build)

1. 10. In `crates/tools/src/run_sim.rs`: campfire `candidates` becomes `[GainMaxHp, MakeRadiant, Buff]` (drop the `HEAL_BELOW_PERCENT` branch — HP is always full); event free-option check reads `option.max_hp`; add `final_hp: i32` to `FightRow` (from the `FightOver` action's `hp`), make `KindTally::add` use `hp_before - final_hp` for won fights, and relabel the boss lines `"max HP entering boss {n}"` with the footnote updated to in-fight loss.
11. 12. Run `cargo test -p jackioh-run --features ts` and commit the regenerated `apps/web/src/wire/generated/` diff.

## Tests

- `crates/run/src/tests.rs`: `r3584000_won_fight_of_each_kind_raises_max_hp_and_refills` (set `state.map[row][0].kind` to Fight/Elite/Ghost/MiniBoss/Boss in turn, win at `hp: 1`; assert `max_hp_bonus == RUN_WIN_MAX_HP`, `hp == run_max_hp`, `damage_taken == max_before - 1`); `r3584000_second_win_stacks` (bonus `2 * RUN_WIN_MAX_HP`, `hp == max`); `r3584001_event_max_hp_cost_lowers_max_and_hp`; `r3584001_event_refusing_below_one_leaves_state_unchanged` (max 1 + cost −1 refused, state equal); rename campfire test to `a_campfire_gains_max_hp_…` (from HP 10: max `30 + 5`, `hp == max`); extend `a_run_played_to_the_end_…` (final `hp == run_max_hp`, `max_hp_bonus == 16 * RUN_WIN_MAX_HP`); extend `a_lost_fight_…` (bonus present, still `Dead` at HP 0); relic/blessing stacking (`temp-big-heart` leveled to 2 counts twice on top of the bonus). - `walk_tests.rs`: no new tests; the existing whole-run walk (both contents) plus `cargo test -p jackioh-run` covers replay.
- `crates/tools`: `cargo test -p jackioh-tools --bin jackioh run_sim`, then `cargo jackioh run-sim --seeds 1` runs clean.
- `apps/web/src/dungeon/map/RunScreen.test.tsx`: update `CONTENT` test-event to a max-HP option (`{ text: "Lose 5 max HP for 5 Coins", maxHp: -5, … }`); B30 campfire test clicks the new testid, expects `{ type: "gainMaxHp" }` and the `"Gain … max HP"` words; event test asserts the max-HP words show. Run `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/dungeon/map/RunScreen.test.tsx`.
- `cargo jackioh spec check` passes; §15 constants table matches `config.rs`.

## Done when

- [ ] Win of each of the five kinds at 1 HP → max +5, HP = new max; loss → `Dead`, HP 0.
- [ ] Every fight setup carries hero health = run max HP, including above `HERO_HEALTH`.
- [ ] Event max-HP cost lowers max and HP; below-1 refused with state unchanged.
- [ ] Campfire max-HP choice raises max by 5; relic/blessing effects stack on top, once per level.
- [ ] `run_fold` replays end-to-end, both walk contents pass, `run-sim --seeds 1` clean.
- [ ] Vitest campfire + event words pass; all commands above green: crate tests, clippy (`-p jackioh-run`, `-p jackioh-tools`), fmt, web file test, `ts` regen diff committed, spec check.
- [ ] PR notes the uncapped in-fight healing finding and names every unsettled decision with its rejected alternative.

## Risks

- Replay determinism: the bonus lives in `RunState` and only `fight_won`/campfire/event arms mutate it, so `run_fold` replays it; `rng_cursor` flow untouched. `walk_tests` + fold-back asserts guard this.
- Hidden info / client rules: unchanged — screens render `runMaxHp`/`runConstants` and send actions; refusal sentences unchanged except the new max-HP one.
- `RunConstants` wire change: additive field, camelCase; old web + new core cannot meet (bundled together), and content JSON is never persisted in `RunFile`, so the `hp`→`max_hp` rename needs no migration.
- `run-sim` tuning drift: HP now ratchets +5/win and campfires add max HP, so boss-HP and HP-lost numbers shift upward by construction; that is the feature, not a regression — read the table accordingly.
- #3496 interplay: do not end, migrate, or special-case kept runs here; that issue owns it.

## Open questions

None for the builder — medium stands (one crate's design; tools and web changes are call sites and presentation). One person-side note: the harness's blocked-by (#3496) must land first or with this, otherwise kept runs with old event JSON fold differently; nothing in this plan handles that on purpose.
```

Every won fight (Fight, Elite, Ghost, mini-boss, final boss) raises the run's max HP by `RUN_WIN_MAX_HP` (5) and refills HP to the new max, so HP outside a fight always equals max HP and every fight starts full; a lost fight still ends the run with HP 0. Events trade max HP (`RunEventOption.hp` renamed to `max_hp`, floor 1) and the campfire's heal becomes "+`RUN_CAMPFIRE_MAX_HP` (5) max HP" (`RunAction::Heal` renamed to `RunAction::GainMaxHp`), with the HUD, campfire/event words, docs (§15.4, §15.6, §15.7, §15.8, constants table; `docs/dungeon-run.md` DR0.3, DR7; `crates/run/README.md`), two rulings (R3584000, R3584001), and `run-sim` reporting max HP at each boss.

## Steps

1. Confirm the engine needs no change (read-only): `heal_hero` is uncapped for heroes (`crates/engine/src/damage.rs`: "units are capped at max health, heroes are not"), and `validate_setup` (`crates/engine/src/state.rs`) requires `hero_health >= 1` with no upper cap. Write the pull request note from this step: a hero starting above `HERO_HEALTH` can heal past its starting health in-fight; the engine is unchanged here.
2. In `crates/run/src/config.rs`, delete `RUN_CAMPFIRE_HEAL_PERCENT` and add `pub const RUN_WIN_MAX_HP: i32 = 5;` (comment `DR5/DR6`) and `pub const RUN_CAMPFIRE_MAX_HP: i32 = 5;` (comment `DR7`), above the `#[cfg(test)]` block. No floor constant: the floor is 1 (decision 3).
3. In `crates/run/src/lib.rs`, add `#[serde(default)] pub max_hp_bonus: i32` to `RunState` (beside `hp`), and make `run_max_hp` return `RUN_MAX_HP + state.max_hp_bonus + passive_total(MaxHp)`. Init it to 0 in `run_create`.
4. Rewrite `fight_won`: clamp the report to `>= 1` only (drop the max clamp); `damage_taken += (max_before - final).max(0)` where `max_before` is `run_max_hp` before the win; then `state.max_hp_bonus += RUN_WIN_MAX_HP; state.hp = run_max_hp(state, content)`. The refill is not counted as `healed` (R3584000). Loss arm unchanged (HP 0, `Dead`).
5. Rename `RunEventOption.hp` to `max_hp` (plain rename, no serde alias — content never persists in `RunFile`; kept runs are #3496's, decision 4). Event arm: refuse with `"not enough max HP"` when `run_max_hp(state, content) + option.max_hp < 1`, state unchanged; else apply inside `with_max_hp(state, content, |s| s.max_hp_bonus += option.max_hp)` and keep the existing `damage_taken`/`healed` delta bookkeeping around it. Coins/tickets/card/artifact logic unchanged (R3584001).
6. Rename `RunAction::Heal` to `GainMaxHp` (wire `"gainMaxHp"`). Campfire arm becomes `with_max_hp(state, content, |s| s.max_hp_bonus += RUN_CAMPFIRE_MAX_HP); state.phase = Map` (no `stats.healed`; a rise is not healing). Radiant/buff/remove arms unchanged.
7. Add `pub campfire_max_hp: usize`… (type `i32`) to `RunConstants` returned from `run_constants()` as `RUN_CAMPFIRE_MAX_HP`, so the client states no number (rule 9).
8. Update `placeholder.json` event options per the table (texts + `hp` → `maxHp` keys).
9. Write `spec/rulings/R3584000.md` (win of any kind: `+RUN_WIN_MAX_HP` bonus then refill; `damage_taken` counts `max_before − final`, refill not healed; Hearthstone semantics) and `R3584001.md` (event floor 1, no new constant; rename needs no alias), each with `proven_in` listing its test file; write `spec/pending/3584.md` with both `**[[R…]] … (issue #3584, …)**` paragraphs; edit §15.4/§15.6/§15.7/§15.8 and the constants table; update `docs/dungeon-run.md` DR0.3/DR7 and `crates/run/README.md`.
10. In `crates/tools/src/run_sim.rs`: campfire `candidates` becomes `[GainMaxHp, MakeRadiant, Buff]` (drop the `HEAL_BELOW_PERCENT` branch — HP is always full); event free-option check reads `option.max_hp`; add `final_hp: i32` to `FightRow` (from the `FightOver` action's `hp`), make `KindTally::add` use `hp_before - final_hp` for won fights, and relabel the boss lines `"max HP entering boss {n}"` with the footnote updated to in-fight loss.
11. Web: `RunHud` in `RunScreen.tsx` renders `{t("HP")}: {max}` (drop `run.hp`); `CampfireScreen` button reads `runConstants().campfireMaxHp` and shows `t("Gain {n} max HP", …)`, sending `{ type: "gainMaxHp" }`; rename the testid; add `"Gain {n} max HP"` to `zh-CN.json` following the file's pattern. `EventScreen` needs no logic change (it renders `option.text`).
